# Douglas Rosenberg

> Full-stack .NET developer building custom websites and web applications for small and medium-sized businesses, plus Blazor/ERP systems work for larger organizations. Currently building an ERP system for a global nonprofit (Franciscan Friars); prior work includes Fortune 10 LLM-document-processing tooling and manufacturing ERP systems.

Brings enterprise-grade engineering discipline (security, performance, accessibility) — honed building sprawling ERP systems — to SMB budgets and timelines. Primary focus: custom websites and web applications for small and medium-sized businesses. Also open to freelance/consulting engagements and full-time opportunities.

## Background
- Current: Full-stack .NET engineer, Friars ERP (Franciscan Friars) — secure data-masking pipeline, Salesforce/ERP sync, 50 custom reports serving 500+ staff
- Prior: Tackle.ai (LLM-powered document processing for a Fortune 10 client), TC Industries (enterprise manufacturing ERP), Shift (Angular/.NET on BridgestoneMarketing.com)
- Core stack: C#, .NET, Blazor, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure, Syncfusion, Figma, Angular, Docker

## Blog posts
- [What Security Headers Do Musician Website Builders Actually Ship?](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/security-headers-musician-platforms/) (2026-09-29): Checks the security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options and more) that Bandzoogle, Squarespace, Wix and WordPress.com actually return, with the caveats on what that does and doesn't show.
- [I Security-Reviewed My Own Deployed App: Cheap Wins, a Key Vault Migration, and What I Chose Not to Fix](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/security-review-own-deployed-app-key-vault/) (2026-09-28): Auditing a live .NET app on Azure: dependency alerts, secret scanning, testing a login lockout, and moving secrets into Key Vault via Managed Identity.
- [One App, Two Audiences: Building a Customer Intake Backend with a Personal ERP Inside It](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/customer-intake-backend-personal-erp/) (2026-09-24): A public lead-intake system and a private personal ERP in one app, and how the data boundary between them is enforced and tested.
- [Enterprise Engineering Discipline, Small-Business Budget: How I Approach SMB Web Development](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/enterprise-discipline-smb-web-development/) (2026-09-16): Why enterprise ERP engineering habits — verified security, performance, and accessibility — translate to small-business web projects, backed by real client work (Sonus Construction Group, Hardware Etc) and shipped products (ArborKin).
- [Rebuilding My Own Musician Site: From a Blazor Template to a Verified Astro Build](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/rebuilding-musician-site-blazor-to-astro/) (2026-09-07): Migrating dougrosenberg.com from a stock Blazor template to Astro on Cloudflare — a verified image-optimization pass, real Lighthouse/E2E checks, and an honest list of what's still open.
- [Why GEO Doesn't Work in a Blazor WASM SPA](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/blazor-wasm-geo-audit/) (2026-09-04): Auditing a client-rendered SPA's crawlability for AI answer engines — what survives a plain HTTP GET, what a robots.txt mistake was blocking, and what prerendering fixes.
- [Building a Family Tree App with Blazor](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/building-family-tree-blazor/) (2026-08-09): Technical deep-dive into ArborKin — tree layout without JavaScript, drag-state ownership, and direct-to-Blob photo uploads.
- [Hello World: Welcome to My Blog](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/hello-world/) (2026-07-21): Introductory post.
- [Building a Modern Portfolio with Blazor](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/building-portfolio/) (2026-07-15): Why this portfolio is built on Blazor WebAssembly.
